messages:
sarah: Heads-up — our CI started failing KMS decrypts after yesterday's key rotation pass. Getting AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt from the worker role.
omar: which key alias?
sarah: alias/ci/encrypt-key. CloudTrail: "errorCode": "AccessDeniedException", "userIdentity": {"type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/ci-worker-role/i-abc123"}
julie: KMS key policy likely restrictive to the role ARN. After assume-role the principal changes to an assumed-role ARN.
mike: paste the Principal section of the key policy.
sarah: 
```
{ "Sid": "AllowCI", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/ci-worker-role"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": "*" }
```
omar: that worked before rotation. Did the rotation actually recreate the CMK?
julie: rotation should keep CMK id and grants; a recreate would produce a new key id and lose grants.
sarah: ran `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/ci/encrypt-key` — creation time is yesterday and key id is new.
mike: bingo. We re-created the CMK (rekey) not rotated. Grants won't exist on the new key and the key policy might not allow assumed-role ARNs.
julie: also check assume-role session policies — if the session policy limits actions to s3:GetObject it will block kms:Decrypt even if the key policy allows it.
omar: quick remediation: update key policy to accept assumed-role ARNs or use condition on aws:PrincipalArn; re-apply the grants used by CI; or point alias back to original key if possible.
sarah: short-term I'm going to add this to the key policy:

```
"Principal": {"AWS": [
  "arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/ci-worker-role",
  "arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/ci-worker-role/*"
]}
```

and reapply the two grants we used for ephemeral decrypts.
mike: also audit assume-role session policy — we do attach a session policy that restricts to s3; that explains lack of kms:Decrypt.
security-bot: note: KMS evaluates the key policy first; a restrictive key policy will deny even if IAM allows.
devops-bot: queued workflow `kms-rotation-check` to run in 15m.
omar: scan CloudTrail for CreateKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion events across accounts for last 7 days.
sarah: update 45m later — applied key policy change and recreated grants. CI is green. Added a decrypt test step to rotation job and a runbook note to avoid recreating CMKs. Opening PR with policy diff and runbook edits.
julie: please include reasoning about principal pattern vs conditions in the PR.
mike: long term: update rotation automation to never recreate keys; if migrating keys, use re-encrypt/migrate path and document ephemeral grant reuse.
security-bot: incident logged: root cause = CMK recreation + restrictive session policy; severity: low; assigned security oncall.
omar: thanks team :thumbsup:
